reasons: The locked preferred level is fully satisfied: NY governing law in 28.1 paired with the pre-existing exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County in 28.2.

The edit is confined to a single replacement of 28.1; the redundant and conflicting Singapore forum grant was removed as necessary to avoid two competing exclusive forums, and no other language was touched.
The fallback jurisdictions (Delaware, California, England and Wales/London) are unmet, but they are a separate bargain and irrelevant given the preferred level is complete.
Untouched terms in 28.2 (personal jurisdiction submission, venue waiver, injunctive-relief carve-out) remain effective; no undefined term, contradiction, or dangling mechanic is introduced.
